name: enumerate maximal cliques with a pivot
mechanism: grow a clique by adding candidates adjacent to all its members, tracking which vertices have already been excluded, and choosing a pivot so that only non-neighbours of the pivot need be branched on

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bron–Kerbosch algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Subgraphs: a technique for finding maximal cliques in an undirected graph
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'MaxCliqueDyn maximum clique algorithm': find a maximum clique in an undirected graph

fails_when: exponentially many cliques exist in the worst case
